passages.S17.title: S17 · Re-wearing an aso-ebi set at a different event
passages.S17.context: She is 35, from Lagos. Two months ago she bought an aso-ebi for her cousin's wedding: a lace blouse and a George wrapper in wine. Now she is going to a church thanksgiving where nobody from that wedding will be present. She wants to re-wear it.
passages.S17-B: The complete wine set as it was worn, with the same head tie and heels.
